title: Jehoahaz becomes king and is imprisoned by Pharaoh Neco
description: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, becomes king of Judah at the age of twenty-three and reigns for three months in Jerusalem. He does what is evil in the Lord's sight. Pharaoh Neco imprisons him at Riblah, imposes a tribute on the land, and makes his brother Eljakim king under the name Jehoiakim. Jehoahaz is taken to Egypt and dies there.
